title: Cabin Crew Interview October 2025 Calendar
excerpt: SpiceJet is hiring freshers as well as experienced crew, with eligibility criteria including Indian nationality, Higher Secondary Certificate (10+2) or awaiting results, and age between 17 years 9 months and 27 years.
content:
Details

Spice Jet is hiring freshers as well as experienced crew. The eligibility criteria is listed below.

Educational qualification

Higher Secondary Certificate (10+2); those who are awaiting results can also apply.

Nationality

Indian

Minimum Age

17 years, 9 months till 27 years

Minimum Height

155 cm for girls; for boys: 173 cm

Weight

In proportion to height

Language

Fluency in Hindi and English

Appearance

Clear complexion with no tattoos, marks, scars, or blemishes on any visible part of the body.

Each student must have successfully completed their higher secondary (i.e. 10+2) from a recognised board.

Students who are awaiting their higher secondary results may also apply; however, confirmation of their admission is subject to submission of the mark sheet certificate within the stipulated timeline.

Failure to submit the required documents shall lead to cancellation of admission along with programme’s fee forfeiture.

Candidates need to clear class II medical test by a certified Aero Medical Centre.

Disclaimer

Spice Star Academy is fair and transparent in shortlisting of a candidate. The selection is strictly on the basis of criteria published on the website.
author: SpiceJet

title: Cabin Attendant (Grade Tr)
excerpt: Female Indian nationals holding a valid Indian passport, aged between 18 to 27 years, with positive body language, well-groomed appearance, no visible tattoos in uniform, and fluency with clear speech in both English and Hindi.
content:
Job Description

Eligibility Criteria

Female Indian nationals with Indian passport, between 18 to 27 years of age.

Educational Qualification Passed 10+2 examination from a recognized board or university.

Communication Fluency and clarity of speech in both English and Hindi.

Height and Weight Minimum of 155 cm, and weight proportionate to BMI.

Appearance Positive body language, well-groomed, with no visible tattoos while in uniform.

Base Availability Candidate should be flexible to relocate at any IndiGo base.

Dress Code (for interview) Half-sleeve shirt, knee-length skirt, stockings, and formal heels.

Competencies

IFS - Communication

IFS - Demonstrating Confidence

IFS - Job Knowledge and Skills (if prior flying/aviation/other experience)

IFS - Personality / Poise / Etiquette / Maintaining Composure

IFS - Presentable Appearance
author: Indigo

title: Officer (T) -Cargo Operations
excerpt: This position is responsible for efficient handling of outbound (domestic / international cargo) from the station and handling of inbound cargo arriving at the station.
content:
Details

Airline: Indigo

Location: Navi Mumbai, India

Department: In-Flight Services

Purpose

This position is responsible for efficient handling of outbound (domestic/international) cargo from the station and handling of inbound cargo arriving at the station.

Job Description

Conduct cargo operations in accordance with applicable regulations and standards as laid down in this manual.

Ensure proper packing, marking and weight is present on the packet/AWB before acceptance.

Ensure cargo is properly manifested as per sales planning.

Ensure cargo is dispatched from warehouse properly with all relevant documents.

Ensure proper documentation and reports are generated.

Ensure proper segregation/trolley make-up are done for flights.

Ensure cargo is properly loaded/unloaded from aircraft.

Ensure proper messages are forwarded to various destinations regarding cargo and documents.

Ensure incoming cargo is properly segregated and delivered to consignee, and ensure proper discrepancy messages are sent if any.

Ensure all relevant daily maintenance functions of equipment are carried out.

Liaise with Customs/AAI/CUT Operator and ensure all Government regulations are met.

Ensure issuance of carting orders for export cargo and delivery orders addressed to Customs.

Ensure that proper booking and reservations for shipments are done on the computer.

Ensure verification and acceptance of cargo and rates/volumes are checked.

Ensure that Cargo Agents issue correct Airway Bills.

Undertake issuance of Airway Bill on behalf of assigned product.

Prepare and execute customs paperwork on behalf of assigned product, if required.

Supervise functions performed by the Ground Handling staff on the ramp.

Supervise the work of loaders and ensure that delegated work is performed in the prescribed manner.

Ensure that Ground Support Equipment is properly maintained and meets safety standards; also ensure all assets are kept clean and serviceable.

Ensure that all safety, security, and SOPs with regard to cargo operations are adhered to.

Be aware of and comply with his/her safety responsibilities and accountabilities as laid down in the IndiGo SMS Manual, Chapter Safety Policy and Objectives.
author: Indigo

title: Cabin Crew / Flight Attendant
excerpt: Cabin Crew members are responsible for ensuring the safety, security, and comfort of passengers on board an aircraft. They provide high-quality customer service, assist passengers during the flight, and handle emergency situations with professionalism and care.
content:
Details

Position: Cabin Crew / Flight Attendant
Airline: Air India

Location: Delhi, India

Department: In-Flight Services

Reports to: Cabin Manager / In-Flight Supervisor

Role Overview

Cabin Crew members are responsible for ensuring the safety, security, and comfort of passengers on board an aircraft. They provide high-quality customer service, assist passengers during the flight, and handle emergency situations with professionalism and care.
